events.text: Ninja ears on! Let's listen to some words.
I can say a word fast. Sun!
Or I can say it slowly...
Fast or slow, it's the same word. Sun!
When I say a word slowly, I can hear the sounds that make up the word. Words are made of sounds!
Your turn! Tap the tortoise, and say it slowly with me.
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast!
Three right answers in a row! Your ninja is getting stronger.
Listen to the very first sound.
Did you notice? Sun and sock start with the same sound...
Tap all the pictures that start with...
You found them both! They both start with...
You can hear the sounds in words. Brilliant listening!
Look! Your pictures are turning into stickers!
Sun, sock, cat, sausage and moon!
Every picture you play with becomes a sticker!
Tap the green arrow to carry on!
Every word starts with a sound. Let's listen for the very first sound!
We hear the sound. Now look: this is how we spell it.
Three right answers in a row! Your ninja is getting stronger.
This is our dojo. Here we listen to sounds, make words, and read them.
We start here, and go this way.
Now I find each sound, one at a time.
Say the sounds... and read the word!
